snippet.title: The PTSD Mod 2 Trailer
snippet.description:
Disclaimer: The PTSD mods is not linked to the actual mental disorder and doesnt aim to make fun of it, it was an unfortunate name I chose  for the mod series at the time and if I could I would go back and change it. Sorry
_____________

Return in this all new epic adventure, full with completely new levels, secrets, weapons and more. Our  mental state is rapidly declining after the events of the first mod, and we must travel on a big journey to find out what is causing this, and put an end to it.

The trailer doesn't do the mod Justice, go check it out for yourself!

Play the mod here: https://www.moddb.com/mods/the-ptsd-mod-2/downloads/ptsd-2

Music by Raxxo: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fl2LMZH0tcU
